headline: Beat on All Counts; Margin Dip Is Optical

highlights: Adjusted for the +23.0% alloy-price pass-through and the -5.0% impact of the wheel assembly exit, net revenue grew 29.5% YoY, well ahead of 2W industry production growth of 16.5%.

Operating EBITDA (excluding other income) grew 30.2% YoY to Rs1.79bn, beating NBIE/Bloomberg estimates by 5.5%/7.2%, while operating EBITDA margin declined by 153bps YoY to 11.5% due to the denominator effect of alloy-price pass-through revenue (company reported: Rs1.85bn; 11.8%).
PAT rose 27.3% YoY to Rs1.02bn, 6.4%/10.7% ahead of NBIE/consensus.  Outlook: Management reiterated its high-teens net revenue growth guidance for FY27, despite a higher H2 base after GST 2.0.
Margins are expected to remain stable or improve modestly in H2FY27 assuming aluminium prices remain around current levels; adjusted for pass-through, margins would be ~13.5% or slightly higher.
valuation: Capex is budgeted at ~Rs7bn for FY27 and ~Rs5bn for FY28, with the fourth Bengaluru plant due by mid-Jan ’27.  Valuation: We continue to retain ASK Automotive as our top pick in the auto ancillary space, supported by its consistent industry outperformance; new growth levers in HPDC alloy wheels, EVs and exports; and strong execution track record.

Accordingly, we maintain our BUY rating with a target price of Rs741, based on 27x Sep-28E EPS. 2QFY27 earnings snapshot – strong topline growth: ASK Automotive reported revenue of Rs15,552mn, 13.5% ahead of NBIE and 13.1% above Bloomberg estimates, growing 47.6% YoY (+14.5% QoQ).
